name: registry
description: Which version of which remote runs on which stand.

scripts.check: for stand in dev3 dev2 dev1 tst; do portal-cli registry check --registry . --stand $stand || exit 1; done
scripts.deploy: for stand in dev3 dev2 dev1 tst; do portal-cli registry build --registry . --stand $stand --out ${PORTAL_INFRA_DIR:-../platform/.infra}/stands/$stand/config.json; done
